provenance: Independent complete original constructor and local repetitions have exact integer peaks. All10000lags were independently converted using Decimal exact rational SI units and five float multiplication orders; worst pairwise difference is recorded in private snspd_roundoff_experiment.json. Conservative nonzero max1e-6bin/mean1e-7bin boundaries cover numeric conversion only, not a one-bin physical accuracy allowance.
